summary: Behavior change: a picked mention is sent with its canonical label. Ordinary labels, ids and types stay byte-identical; hidden characters, { } <! -->, line breaks, edge whitespace and over 120 code points change the label; a type or id with hostile characters is sent without a marker.
howTo: Nothing to do for the new default. Label changes: NFC; edge whitespace trimmed; control and line-separator runs one space (NBSP, U+3000, space runs stay); { } <! --> --!> become ｛ ｝ ‹! --› --!›; format characters, default ignorables, private use, noncharacters, U+2800 and lone surrogates removed, except one ZWJ between emoji, one ZWJ/ZWNJ between letters of a joining script, the England/Scotland/Wales flag tags, one VS15/VS16 after an emoji (digits, # and * only in a keycap), one IVS after Han, one Mongolian FVS; over 120 code points cut at a grapheme boundary with …. A mention whose type or id has control, format, invisible, private-use, unassigned or noncharacters, }, {{, <!, --> or --!> keeps its typed token without a marker, so the model loses the id; the chat warns once per type (dev). Entry points: legacy mentions config, completion items, addActiveMention, addMention/insertMention/setValue with app-built mentions, stored drafts and queue items. Spaces, :, <, >, {, capitals stay valid. An app that needs the old format sets mentions: { serialize: { labels: 'raw' } }; maxLabelLength (1-120) cuts shorter. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Mention markers.
